description: This is a wooden display cabinet with two shelves and a drawer at the bottom. The cabinet is designed to showcase a collection of items, with each item placed on a pedestal. The top shelf holds three items, while the bottom shelf also holds three items. The drawer has two brass knobs. The overall design has a rustic and somewhat aged appearance, suggesting it might be part of an older or themed collection, possibly related to gaming or fantasy due to the nature of the displayed items.
